tagline: AI/ML Engineer and Founder & CEO of SAKRA VISION, pursuing B.Tech CSE (AI) at PBR VITS, completed AI & ML Programme at Vishlesan i-Hub, IIT Patna, and participating in the VINS Internship with Vicharanashala Lab, IIT Ropar.

summary: Likith Naidu Anumakonda is an AI/ML Engineer and Founder & CEO of SAKRA VISION, an AI product studio and technology venture specializing in AI application development, machine learning, computer vision, LLM and RAG applications, AI agents and automation, and software and web application development.

He is currently pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) at PBR VITS, Kavali, Andhra Pradesh, and successfully completed the Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Programme offered by Vishlesan i-Hub, IIT Patna (July 2025 – June 2026).
He is currently participating in the Vicharanashala Internship (VINS), associated with the Vicharanashala Lab for Education Design at IIT Ropar (October 7, 2026 – December 5, 2026, ongoing).
He is also a Classical Pianist and Author of "Echoes of an Unsaid Goodbye".
